visualCharacteristics.purpose: Gallery of square design swatches, each linking to its detail page
visualCharacteristics.description: 4-up grid of square surface-inset images with a single linked design-name caption beneath, no description

contentPattern.structure: image cell, then a cell with the linked design name
contentPattern.rationale: Repeating look-alike items that wrap and each link to a detail page: Cards.

reuseGuidance: Use for product or design galleries where each item is just an image and a linked name. Use cards-teaser when items carry a heading, description and CTA.

blockContent.description: Four design tiles: inset image + linked design name, each to a design detail page

rows: Text: optional heading, description, CTA link
structure.notes: One row per card. Section 2: image + linked design name paragraph. Section 4: image + H3 linked title. Section 6: image + H3 + paragraph + link.

usageDescription: Grid of square product/design swatches (4-up on desktop, 2-up on mobile). One row per card: image cell, and a cell with the linked design name. The whole tile links to the caption link.
